name: mailbox
description: Multi-mailbox IMAP/SMTP control plane exposed as a REST API and MCP server on a single port — read, search, send, mark-seen, and delete mail across multiple inboxes.

mailbox_url.title: mailboxd URL
mailbox_url.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd instance, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (sets MAILBOX_URL).

mailbox_token.title: mailboxd bearer token
mailbox_token.description: One of the mailboxd server's bearer tokens; not needed only if it runs with MAILBOX_ALLOW_NO_AUTH=true (sets MAILBOX_TOKEN).
